note: Candidate 1's prompt ensembles, written in Step 1 from the definitions below before any prompt vector, cosine or fit existed, and without looking at any frame. Same shape as the archived genre_prompts.json (label, parent, prompts), so genre_text.py tokenizes it as is. The criterion reads this first version unless a revision is written blind (plan.md, Pre-registered criteria). Each pair is used as a contrast: `ball visible` minus `no ball`, `contested carrier` minus `single player`.

labels.label: ball visible
labels.definition: The ball of the game is in the frame, in a hand, in the air or on the ground, whatever its size.
prompts: a photo with a ball visible in the frame
a sports photo where the ball can be seen
a ball flying in the air during a game

labels.label: no ball
labels.definition: The ball is not in the frame.
prompts: a photo with no ball in the picture
a sports photo where the ball is not visible
players on the court with no ball in view

labels.label: contested carrier
labels.definition: The player in control of the ball and at least one opposing player are both in the frame.
prompts: a ball carrier contested by a defender
a player with the ball guarded closely by an opponent
two opposing players fighting for the ball
a player dribbling the ball while a defender blocks the way
an attacker with the ball and a defender in front of them

labels.label: single player
labels.definition: One player is shown alone, with no opponent near them.
prompts: one athlete alone in the frame with no opponent
a player on their own with nobody near them
a lone player without any defender
